translation: Ah, right…

Did you read through all of our material from
earlier, Suzumiya?

I think I scanned through most of it. Why do
you ask?

Nagato found an article about a unique-
looking drawing…
Ahh, that terrible drawing.

Seemed like it was drawn by one of the North
High alumni, but they clearly have no taste.

Even I drew something better than that in art
class.
Haru-nyan, you drew something?

During a lesson, yeah. And it was pretty good,
if I say so myself.
What kind of drawing was it?
Let's see… If I had to put it into a word…
Revolution!
Revo… lution?

It was a piece that seized a boring society
by the legs and flipped it on its head!
I don't really get it…
Hmm, it's hard to explain.

Well whatever, it was way better than that
sad excuse for artwork.

Oh right, how about we decorate the clubroom
with some new artwork sometime?
Ah, that sounds really nice.

You can observe my artistic prowess just by
looking at the SOS Brigade logo.
…Maybe we shouldn't after all…
